description:
This strategy made me $179,000 last month.

And it’s built around just two indicators.

VWAP + EMA9.

VWAP helps me identify market direction and the areas where I’m looking for entries.

EMA9 helps me confirm momentum and manage my exits once I’m in the trade.

No complicated chart.
No stacking 10 different indicators.
Just a simple strategy with clear rules that I execute consistently.

Those are my personal results, not a guarantee of future performance.

Comment “SETUP” below and follow me to get my free trading guide.

Want to trade live with me and join the community?

Click the link in my bio, sign up for the monthly membership, and get a 7-day free trial.
